prompt:
Use aged paper, restrained sepia color, halftone print texture, and archival cutout framing.
Treat photographs and documents as tactile evidence layers with legible hierarchy.
Avoid: Glossy modern gradients, neon color, and playful preschool proportions.
Composition: Organize evidence in measured overlapping planes with one dominant archival focal point.
Composition: Preserve readable margins, captions, and document edges instead of filling every gap.
Create a sophisticated cinematic analog PAPER COLLAGE for a melancholy Chinese music video, landscape 16:9 at 1672 by 941 pixels. A large weathered rectangular window occupying the left-middle of the frame, vertical wooden mullion and one horizontal bar, seen straight-on, overlooking misty blue-grey distant trees in rain. Everything made from textured sepia archive print and torn paper. Window frame and old desk surface form a complete distinct middle paper plane, rich dark indigo shadow against ivory paper, irregular cut edges. A few layered faded blank postcard corners along the bottom-left and a delicate dried botanical sprig at far right form a separate sparse foreground plane. The center-right remains spacious faded ivory paper with beautiful grain and very faint rain texture. The bottom 18 percent is quiet ivory paper, no busy details, to hold editable song lyrics. Elegant gallery artwork, refined physical paper shadows, subtle halftone, no cartoon. No envelope or letter yet: it will be a separately animated prop. No people, no text, no lettering, no watermark. Three coherent depth planes, not a contact sheet. Keep all window mullions straight and clean; no broken frame. Cool quiet nocturnal melancholy, subtle warm ivory glimmer.
